name: Multi-step form
summary: Collect information in small, ordered chunks: one form when short, Steps when long or dependent.
whenToUse: Tasks whose later questions depend on earlier answers
whenNotToUse: Settings that apply immediately: use Toggles with actions
structure: Form (≤ 6 inputs) or Steps with one topic per step
Labels above inputs, help text under labels
Verb-first submit label as the single primary action

checks.description: Inputs are collected in a Form or in Steps
No more than 6 inputs are visible at once; longer tasks are split into steps
The submit button says what happens next

journey.goal: Provide the information the task needs
checkpoints: Every required input has a value
Validation passes for each step before moving on
journey.done: The submit (or finish) event is sent with the collected values

agent: Fill each input by its label, then activate the submit button. In Steps, use Next until the finish button appears.
sources: GOV.UK: one thing per page, question pages
